per_candidate.id: s2:Revealing the atmospheres of highly irradiated exoplanets: from ultra-hot Jupite

rationale: Paper 2410.23436 investigates the impact of magnetic effects and cloud formation on the thermal profiles of hot Jupiter atmospheres, directly addressing the question. Paper 2406.12512 proposes a method to measure magnetic field effects on ion velocities, contributing evidence on magnetic influences. Together, they provide substantive new evidence on parts of the question.
